create_longformer_config: create a LongformerConfig instance with default transformer model settings
create_longformer_config_attention_windo: create a LongformerConfig with a custom attention window size for sliding window attention
create_longformer_config_model: create a LongformerConfig and initialize a LongformerModel from it
create_longformer_config_onnx: create a LongformerConfig with onnx_export enabled for ONNX model export
create_longformer_config_custom_params: create a LongformerConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
